rule Emotet_C2_Communication {
    meta:
        description = "Detects network traffic to known Emotet C2 servers"
        reference = "Internal Incident INC-2026-0711"
        author = "Security Team"

    rule:
        id = 20260711-0001
        comment = "Emotet C2 Communication"

        network_traffic:
            action = "outbound"
            destination_ip = ["91.219.236.174"]
            destination_port = 443
            protocol = "tcp"

            # HTTP User-Agent known to be used by Emotet
            http_request:
                header = "User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 6.1; Trident/7.0; rv:11.0) Like Gecko"

            # Behavioral indicators
            flow_bits: "&is_http=Set,!is_ssl=Set; etl"

        # Set initial risk score
        risk_score: 20

        # Add additional risk if there are multiple connections
        risk_score += 3 * (network_traffic.connections > 1)

        # Add additional risk if the traffic is during non-business hours
        risk_score += 10 * (is_non_business_hours())

        # Determine severity based on risk score
        severity = if(risk_score >= 70, "high", 
                      if(risk_score >= 40, "medium", "low"))

        # Add tags for alert categorization
        tags = ["attack.command_and_control", "attack.t1071", "malware.Emotet"]
}
